# Kenney licence statement (as published on kenney.nl)

Retrieved 2026-10-13. This file records what kenney.nl states. It does not prove that any particular file in this repository came from a Kenney pack; see `../ASSETS.md` for that question.

## General statement

Source: https://kenney.nl/support ("Common questions")

> Can I use the game assets in a (commercial) project?
> Yes, all game assets on the asset pages are public domain licensed (CC0). You're free to use them, even in commercial projects. For full details, see the included license file or visit the asset page.

> Is attribution required when using the game assets?
> Attribution is not required, but if you choose to give credit you can do so by mentioning "Kenney". Do not use our logo, as it is reserved for official projects by our studio.

## Limits of this record

- The pack archives were not downloaded. The "included license file" that kenney.nl refers to was not read.
- The font files shipped in this repository carry embedded metadata naming a different licence (CC BY-SA 3.0). See `../ASSETS.md`, section "Fonts".
